The affixes यत् and खञ् come after the word मास in denoting 'age'.

Terms: यत् and खञ्

The word मस्कर means 'a bamboo', and मस्करिन् means 'a medicant monk'.

Terms: सुट् augment

The augment नुम् is added after the vowel of the roots मस्ज् and नश् before an affix beginning with any consonant other than a semi-vowel or a nasal.

Terms: नुम् augment
